## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue and what a user or consumer observes after this change.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Identify anything not verified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Targets `develop` and contains a focused change.
- [ ] Public behavior is covered by meaningful tests and documentation.
- [ ] Strict types, package boundaries and coverage gates remain intact.
- [ ] UI changes include keyboard, mobile and accessibility verification.
- [ ] Compatibility, performance or ownership tradeoffs are explained.
- [ ] No credentials, private data or generated candidate archives are included.

## Related issue and limitations

Link the issue and record remaining limitations, if any.
